item.title: Kikobeats/awesome-network-js Aug 21st - Aug 27th, 2017
item.description:
High level

  • instant.iostars2.9k – Streaming file transfer over WebTorrent.
  • webtorrentstars24.6k – BitTorrent over WebRTC.
  • hypervisionstars437 – P2P Television.

    • Modules

  • magnet-uristars189 – Parse a magnet URI and return an object of keys/values.
  • torrent-discoverystars186 – Discover BitTorrent and WebTorrent peers.
  • airplay-serverstars251 – A low level AirPlay server.
  • castnowstars96 – simple chromecast player.
  • discovery-swarmstars360 – A network swarm that uses discovery-channelstars295 to find peers. Also check webrtc-swarmstars353.
  • dns-packetstars125 – Abstract-encoding compliant module for encoding / decoding DNS packets. Also see dns-socketstars94.
  • etcdjsstars57 – Low level etcd v2 client written in Javascript with failover support.
  • geocode-wifistars26 – Get yours latitude/longitude based on your wifi access point.
  • hash-to-portstars33 – Hash a value to a valid port.
  • hyperdbstars734 – Distributed scalable database.
  • ip-packetstars37 – Encode/decode raw ip packets.
  • network-addressstars62 – Get the local network address of your machine.
  • network-simulatorstars37 – Simulate a low-level computer network.
  • rtsp-streamstars78 - A transport agnostic RTSP serial multiplexer module for Node.
  • simple-peerstars5.7k – Simple WebRTC video/voice and data channels.
  • simple-websocketstars164 – Simple, EventEmitter API for WebSockets.
  • torrent-streamstars1.8k – The low level streaming torrent engine that peerflix uses.
  • udp-packetstars44 – Encode/decode raw udp packets.

    • Protocols

  • bittorrent-dhtstars1k – BitTorrent DHT protocol implementation.
  • bittorrent-protocolstars294 – BitTorrent peer wire protocol implementation.
  • bittorrent-trackerstars1.3k – BitTorrent tracker (client & server) implementation

item.title: Kikobeats/awesome-network-js Feb 29th - Mar 6th, 2016
item.description:
High level

  • peercaststars480 – Like peerflix but for Chromecast.
  • peerflixstars5.7k – Streaming torrent client.
  • peervisionarystars43 – Stream p2p content over your local network.
  • peerwikistars306 – browse all of wikipedia using bittorrent.
  • screencatstars2.9k – WebRTC screensharing app.
  • signalhubstars620 – Simple signalling server that can be used to coordinate handshaking with webrtc or other fun stuff.
  • torrent-mountstars1.2k – Mount a torrent (or magnet link) as a filesystem in real time using torrent-stream and fuse.
  • webcatstars424 – pipe across the web using WebRTC.
  • websocketdstars15.6k – Turn any program that uses stdin/stdout into a WebSocket server.

    • Protocols

  • castv2stars706 – An implementation of the Chromecast CASTV2 protocol.
  • ipfsstars1k – The InterPlanetary File System, a new peer-to-peer hypermedia protocol.
  • k-bucketstars138 – Kademlia DHT K-bucket implementation as a binary tree.
  • k-rpcstars75 – Implementation of the k-rpc protocol used the BitTorrent DHT. Also see k-rpc-socketstars20.
  • mdnsstars814 – mdns/zeroconf/bonjour service discovery.
  • multicast-dnsstars405 – Low level multicast-dns implementation.
  • peervisionstars96 – Live p2p streaming protocol.
  • polostars243 – A zero configuration service discovery module.
  • rtsp-serverstars27 – A low level module for creating RTSP servers.
  • utp-nativestars93 – micro transport protocol, a network protocol similar to tcp that runs on top of udp.
  • hypercorestars1.9k – A p2p network for distributing and replicating static feeds of binary data.
